## How was it verified?

<!-- CI runs lint, typecheck and build. Say what you checked beyond that. -->

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (lint, typecheck, build)
- [ ] Checked in a browser at mobile and desktop widths
- [ ] Keyboard navigation still works (tab order, visible focus)

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data added — `.env.local` is for real
      values, `.env.example` is a template and **is committed**
- [ ] Site copy stays factual: no invented projects, statistics, experience or
      credentials
- [ ] Any new animation respects `prefers-reduced-motion`
- [ ] Content added to `src/content/notes/` has complete frontmatter
